description: This file defines the Ext.ux.grid.GridFilters class, a plugin for Ext JS 3.3.0 that adds advanced filtering capabilities to grid components, including features like multiple filter types, state management, and integration with grid headers and paging.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.GridFilters
classes.description: A plugin class extending Ext.util.Observable that provides filtering functionalities for Ext JS grids, supporting multiple filter types, state persistence, and UI integration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GridFilters plugin with configuration, setting up filter collection and deferred update task.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a grid or paging toolbar, binding store and setting up event handlers.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Restores filter states from saved configuration during grid state restoration.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current active filters into the grid's state object.

methods.name: onRender
methods.description: Handles grid rendering, sets up refresh event listener and creates filter menu.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and destroys filter menu.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes and destroys all filters from the collection.

methods.name: bindStore
methods.description: Binds the plugin to a data store, setting up load event handlers.

methods.name: onReconfigure
methods.description: Handles grid reconfiguration, re-binding store and resetting filters.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Creates the filter submenu in the grid header menu.

methods.name: getMenuFilter
methods.description: Retrieves the filter associated with the clicked header.

methods.name: onMenu
methods.description: Handles the display of the filter menu when the header menu is invoked.

methods.name: onCheckChange
methods.description: Handles checkbox state changes in the filter menu.

methods.name: onBeforeCheck
methods.description: Prevents deactivating filters that are not activatable.

methods.name: onStateChange
methods.description: Handles filter state changes, triggers reloads and updates UI.

methods.name: onBeforeLoad
methods.description: Prepares parameters for remote filtering before store loads.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Applies local filtering after store load.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Updates header styles on view refresh.

methods.name: updateColumnHeadings
methods.description: Adds or removes CSS classes on headers based on filter activity.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the store data applying current filters, either locally or remotely.

methods.name: getRecordFilter
methods.description: Creates a validator function for active filters to filter records.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to the collection and sets up event listening.

methods.name: addFilters
methods.description: Adds multiple filters based on column model or array of configs.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves a filter by dataIndex.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Deactivates all filters without removing their configuration.

methods.name: getFilterData
methods.description: Returns an array of data for all active filters.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Builds a query object from active filters, supporting JSON encoding or query string format.

methods.name: cleanParams
methods.description: Removes filter-related parameters from a query parameter object.

methods.name: getFilterClass
methods.description: Returns the filter class for a given filter type, supporting dynamic loading.
